shortDefinition.en: The selected point or region of the frame that the camera uses for focusing or tracking.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 相机用于对焦或跟踪的所选画面点位或区域。

en: A larger area increases coverage but does not tell the camera which subject matters most to you.
zh-cn: 更大区域扩大了覆盖范围，却不能告诉相机哪个主体对你最重要。

example.en: A single point can target one building detail, while a zone allows a moving subject more room in a selected region.
example.zh-cn: 单点可瞄准建筑的一处细节，区域则让运动主体在选定范围内有更多活动空间。

sources.title: Autofocus — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Single-point, zone, wide and tracking behavior, and focus-area selection.
